name: io.github.sepehr071/khodro45-mcp
title: Khodro45 Used Cars
description: Read-only Khodro45 (khodro45.com) Iran used cars: listings, inspection reports, price estimate.

environmentVariables.name: KHODRO45_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Khodro45 requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
